data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'mellos', meaning 'sweet'. In ancient Greek culture, this name was given to girls with charming personalities and endearing dispositions. The name Melli carries a sense of warmth, kindness, and love that continues to resonate in Christian communities today. The name Melli carries the meaning “Amable, Loveable” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Melli usually hope their child will grow to embody amable, loveable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
